an6.43:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.43:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an6.43:1.3: Sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:--
an6.43:1.4: Āyām' Ānanda yena pubbārāmo Migāramātu pāsādo ten' upasaṅkamissāma divāvihārāyā ti.
an6.43:1.5: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.43:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbārāmo Migāramātu pāsādo ten' upasaṅkami.
an6.43:2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:--
an6.43:2.3: Āyām' Ānanda yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten' upasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitun ti.
an6.43:2.4: Evaṃ bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.43:2.5: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten' upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
an6.43:2.6: Pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno. 2.
an6.43:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena rañño Pasenadi-Kosalassa Seto nāma nāgo mahāturiyatāḷitavāditena pubbakoṭṭhakā paccuttarati.
an6.43:3.2: Api 'ssu taṃ jano disvā evam āha
an6.43:3.3: ‘abhirūpo vata bho rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata bho rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata bho rañño nāgo, kāyupapanno vata bho rañño nāgo, nāgo vata bho nāgo' ti.
an6.43:3.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.43:3.5: ‘hatthim eva nu kho bhante mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evam āha:
an6.43:3.6: nāgo vata bho nāgo ti udāhu aññam pi kañci mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evam āha: nāgo vata bho nāgo' ti?
an6.43:3.7: ‘Hatthim pi kho Udāyi mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evam āha:
an6.43:3.13: manussam pi kho Udāyi mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evam āha:
an6.43:3.15: Api c' Udāyi yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā, tam ahaṃ nāgo ti brūmī' ti.
an6.43:4.2: yāva subhāsitañ c' idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā
an6.43:4.3: "api c' Udāyi yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā, tam ahaṃ nāgo ti brūmī" ti.
an6.43:4.4: Idañ ca panāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā subhāsitaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodāmi:
